single.rationale: America's Car-Mart operates a high-risk subprime auto lending business with persistent negative free cash flow (-$53M in FY2025), alarming credit losses (33% provision in FY2025), and 29% of receivables modified for financial difficulty. Despite improved underwriting, revenue has stagnated for three consecutive years while the company faces significant headwinds from tariffs, inventory costs, regulatory scrutiny, and challenging economic conditions affecting its financially fragile customer base.
